notes.title: Lots of updates for Car-toon Chaos
notes.notes:
[h3]BIG UPDATES FOR CAR-TOON CHAOS[/h3]
Minimap now rotates towards your vision on flat screen
New Multiplayer map added "Lost City"
Terrain by robot lab now less likely to get stuck in
Performance bugs fixed for "Protecting the mayor" level
Button in cutscenes bigger now for VR

notes.notes:
[img style="margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;" ]https://shared.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2867200/header.jpg?t=1737812845[/img]
The VR controls should now be fixed for every controller type! Also the fade to black from the pc version has carried over to the vr port. If this patch did or didn't work for you comment below. Thanks and have fun causing chaos!

notes.title: VIRTUWHEEL FURY ROAD: EARLY ACCESS / DEMO IS RELEASED!!!
notes.notes:
VIrtuwheel Fury Road's Early access is now available for free! To get the game you have to go to the steam page and click this button: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974890/c5159ad565498424742bdb7a00f16706e993071c.png[/img]

The game can be played with Mouse + Keyboard, Controller, or in VR. In this early access, you must defeat the skullker, a terrorist who is raging through the city with his gang of skele-punks. However if you attack the innocent cars, the police will come after you as well! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974890/20d9e5fa59a951123704d9b0c0cf8a6046fc2676.png[/img]

Stay tuned for future updates, which plan to include multiplayer, more levels, survival modes and more. Also side note, the T-Rex does not make an appearance in the first update but he will soon enough . . .
